diagnosis.summary: High-frequency vibration energy on P-101 has been rising steadily since 08:55 while overall vibration and temperatures are still near normal. This is the early signature of a bearing defect described in the manual, and it fits the history: the drive-end bearing is 14 months old and the last re-greasing was skipped.

alternatives.why_less_likely: Misalignment raises overall vibration together with bearing temperature and motor current (P101-TS-03); here only high-frequency energy has moved.
Impeller imbalance (P101-TS-05) raises overall vibration at running speed but not high-frequency bearing energy.

evidence.detail: HF vibration energy is 3.9 sigma above its learned baseline and rising about 0.05 g per hour since 08:55.
Overall vibration is still in the normal range (1.9 mm/s), which matches an early-stage bearing defect rather than imbalance or misalignment.
Manual: high-frequency energy rising first, before overall vibration and bearing temperature, is the early sign of bearing wear; typical progression to seizure is about 2 days at full load.
The scheduled bearing re-greasing in July was skipped.
Drive-end bearing last replaced 14 months ago.
Replacement drive-end bearing is in stock (2 units, Store B-14).

fix_steps: Confirm the reading with the handheld vibration analyser on the drive-end bearing housing (P101-TS-01).
Re-grease both bearings now per P101-PR-03 to slow the damage.
Plan a stop within the next 24 hours and switch the cooling duty to the standby arrangement.
Isolate the pump: lockout/tagout of the motor and close suction and discharge valves (P101-SAF-01).
Replace the drive-end bearing 6309 C3 following P101-PR-01; replace the non-drive-end bearing if worn.
Check shaft alignment after reassembly (P101-PR-02) and record readings.
Restart, run 30 minutes and confirm HF vibration energy is back near baseline.

parts.name: Deep groove ball bearing 6309 C3 (drive end)
Lithium bearing grease EP2, 400 g cartridge

safety: Lock out and tag out the motor before opening the bearing housing (P101-SAF-01).
Bearing housing can be above 60 °C: wear gloves.
